injuries.longComment: Gray was a minor factor in the passing game, with his lone reception gaining 11 yards late in the third quarter. Meanwhile, No. 1 tight end Travis Kelce paced Kansas City with 72 receiving yards on four catches. Gray had a nice two-game run with a combined six catches for 97 yards across Weeks 6 and 7, but since then he's tallied just three receptions for 26 yards and a touchdown across his subsequent two games.
injuries.shortComment: Gray caught his only target for 11 yards Sunday in a 35-12 win against the Jets.

injuries.longComment: Earlier Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network relayed that the Eagles agreed to send Ebiketie to the Bengals in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round pick. The trade wasn't cancelled due to concerns over Ebiketie's physical; instead, the Bengals opted to call it off since they would have lost a third-round compensatory pick if the deal was completed, per Rapoport. The Eagles could still look to move Ebiketie elsewhere prior to Tuesday's deadline, but barring another trade, he'll suit up for Philadelphia in its Week 10 game against Pittsburgh.
injuries.shortComment: Ebiketie will remain with the Eagles after his reported trade to the Bengals on Tuesday fell through and won't be completed, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

injuries.longComment: Mitchell has been elevated each of the past three weeks and has logged at least six touches in every game during that span. Against the Giants in Week 9, he recorded six yards on three carries and caught three passes for 20 yards on four targets. The Eagles would need to sign Mitchell to the 53-man roster in order for him to be eligible to play in their next game, which will be Sunday, Nov. 22, versus Pittsburgh following a Week 10 bye. That opportunity for Mitchell could depend on whether Tank Bigsby (abdomen) and/or Will Shipley (foot) return from IR.
injuries.shortComment: Mitchell reverted to Philadelphia's practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

injuries.longComment: With Saquon Barkley and Elijah Mitchell healthy atop the backfield depth chart, Blue was limited to eight snaps on special teams. Unable to find his way onto the field in the Eagles' injury-ruined backfield this season, Blue appears to truly be a last resort option in the Philly offense.
injuries.shortComment: Blue didn't play an offensive snap in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants.
